name: Easy "Everything Spice" Roasted Broccoli & Asparagus Caesar with Walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces. Divide asparagus and broccoli between two baking sheet pans, then drizzle with oil and season with spices (decrease or omit salt if included in the Everything seasoning). Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
1 (510 g) bag broccoli florets
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp everything bagel seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are starting to soften, remove from oven. Add walnuts to the baking sheets, stir to combine, then spread back out in an even layer. Return baking sheets to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender and starting to brown, 10 minutes more. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
When the veggies are cool, place in a large bowl along with romaine, croutons, dressing, and Parmesan. Gently toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (255 g) bag chopped romaine lettuce
1 ½ cups croutons
¾ cup Caesar dressing
½ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates and enjoy!
